new_value: {"notes":"Upstream check 2026-10-17: the original suspicion is NOT A BUG — random_grease_value is only used in Capabilities::with_grease for RFC 9420 registries (ciphersuite, extension, proposal, credential types), where the 15 values are correct; OpenMLS never generates component-ID GREASE. Smaller related issue, NOT REPORTED: component.rs ComponentType has Grease8A8A..GreaseEAEA and From\u003cComponentId\u003e maps 0x8A8A-0xEAEA to those instead of Private, contradicting mls-extensions-10 §7.5 (only 0x0A0A-0x7A7A are GREASE). Impact looks cosmetic (ComponentType only used to build named IDs; UnknownComponentId::new accepts IDs \u003c 0x8000). mimi-mls's own §7.5 generator stays correct either way."}
